Class BlazeBiteIntegrationService

@RestResource(urlMapping='/blazebite/v1/action/*')
global without sharing class BlazeBiteIntegrationService

REST API endpoint for BlazeBite POS integration with Firebase/Firestore. Provides a unified action-based interface for handling various integration operations including email notifications and account synchronization. Supports multiple actions via POST requests to /blazebite/v1/action/*. Implements standardized error handling with RestServiceResponse and centralized error logging.

Methods

@HttpPost
global static void execute()

Processes incoming POST requests and routes them to appropriate service handlers based on the action specified in the URL path. Extracts the action from the request URI and delegates to specialized service classes. Sets HTTP response via RestContext.response with appropriate status codes (204 success, 404 not found, 500 error). All responses use RestServiceResponse for consistent formatting.

Supported actions:

  • sendEmail: Sends custom email to specified addresses via SendEmailService
  • sendWelcomeEmail: Sends templated welcome email via SendEmailTemplateService
  • syncAccount: Synchronizes account data from Firebase to Salesforce via AccountSyncService
